now.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
now.text: In episode 3, Butane burns down a building to make way for a high-rise. Spider-Man beats him and finds a strange symbol on his gear.

proposed.text: In episode 2, Butane burns down a building as part of an insurance scam. Spider-Man beats him and finds a strange symbol on his gear.

changes.evidence: Butane's fight is in episode 2 ('Peter finds an arsonist named Butane who has been hired to destroy a building ... as part of an insurance scam ... notices a stylized infinity logo on his equipment'). Episode 3 is the Vasquez/Sanders jewelry robbery. The motive is an insurance scam, not a high-rise.

proposed.title: Spider-Man 3
proposed.text: Learning that Norman's death was not Spider-Man's fault, Harry joins Peter against Venom and Sandman. He takes the glider blow meant for Peter and dies of his wounds.

changes.evidence: Spider-Man 3: after the butler reveals Norman's death was not Spider-Man's fault, 'Harry arrives and helps Peter subdue Marko. Brock attempts to impale Peter with Harry's glider, but Harry jumps in the way and is impaled instead ... Harry reconciles with Peter before he dies from his injuries.' The file ends with Harry turning Peter away, status At large, with no death record.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: At Happy's condo, Peter cures Otto with Stark technology. Otto later helps the Spider-Men cure Max at the Statue of Liberty and is sent home.

changes.evidence: No Way Home: Peter 'takes the villains to Happy Hogan's apartment. He uses Stark Industries technology to cure Octavius'; at the Statue of Liberty 'Octavius helps cure Dillon', and everyone then returns to their universes. The file ends at k3 with Otto 'In custody' and no record of his cure or change of side.

now.title: Spider-Man (1967)
now.text: In episode 10, snubbed by the Science Hall of Fame, Dr. Matto Magneto seeks revenge and attacks Spider-Man with a magnetic gun.

changes.evidence: Episode 10 ('The Revenge of Dr Magneto') ends with Magneto beaten by anti-magnetic webbing; Marvel Animated wiki: 'Dr. Magneto was later defeated by Spider-Man and turned over to the police.'

now.title: Spider-Man (1967)
now.text: In episode 6, the Green Goblin hypnotizes J. Jonah Jameson to summon demons from the spirit world.

changes.evidence: Episode 6 ('The Witching Hour') ends with Spider-Man foiling the plan in a graveyard: 'Spider-Man leaves the Goblin webbed up for the police.' He is next seen escaping in episode 17 ('Magic Malice').

now.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
now.text: In episode 8, Spider-Man breaks into the High Evolutionary's tower and runs into Electro.

proposed.text: In episode 8, Spider-Man breaks into the High Evolutionary's power plant and runs into Electro.

changes.evidence: Episode 8 ('Ill-Met by Moonlight'): the Resistance enlists Spider-Man 'into breaking into the High Evolutionary's power plant. Here, he confronts an electric eel that is Counter-Earth's Bestial version of Electro.' It is a power plant, not a tower.
